arcSummary: Fenna dismantled her family's mill at nine to see how it worked. The Anchorhold is the one machine she cannot take apart, and it is driving her wonderful.

stages.title: The Itch
stages.summary: She has formally requested permission to dismantle the anchor. There is a diagram. There are contingencies. The answer is still no.

stages.title: A Broken Working
stages.summary: A field-found mechanism nobody can fix by force. She would like to try understanding at it.

stages.title: Maintenance
stages.summary: She has stopped asking to take the anchor apart. She has started asking something better.
